summary: Rank One Computing Corp (ROC) filed an 8-K on June 23, 2026, reporting its agreement to acquire 100% of ZTC Holdco, Inc. for aggregate consideration of $500,000 cash at closing (subject to adjustments for debt, expenses, and net working capital), $2.5 million in restricted stock (vesting over three years), and up to $7 million in revenue share payments over seven years. ROC will also grant up to $500,000 in retention RSUs. Closing requires regulatory approvals, third-party consents, employment agreements, and completion of ZTC's 2024-2025 audit. Watch for audit completion and regulatory timing; risk-arb centers on financing and clearance.
